snippet.title: Astral Wizards - Official Trailer | Neon Roguelike Survivor (Android)
snippet.description:
The swarm is endless. So is your magic.

Play now for free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.roleaf.astralwizards

And visit our website at https://astralwizards.com/

Astral Wizards is a free roguelike survivor in neon pixel art, made for one-handed play on your phone. Pick a wizard, walk into the horde and let your spells fire on their own. Level up, evolve your weapons into screen-filling light shows and take down the boss of every world.

★ 18 weapons, 18 evolutions
★ 9 wizards, 36 spell skins
★ 10 cosmic worlds, 10 bosses
★ 100+ missions, 33 Google Play Games achievements, Hard mode
★ Free, offline, no pay-to-win



#AstralWizards #Roguelike #MobileGames
